title: EnhancedBFT: Reproducibility Artefact
description: Source code, configuration, and a representative 512-node AWS EKS run for the paper 'EnhancedBFT: Optimizing Byzantine Consensus for Blockchains via Sharding, Pipelining, and Fault-Adaptive Recovery — A Same-Implementation Comparison Against RapidChain on Single-Shard Workloads'. Contains the EnhancedBFT implementation, the RapidChain reimplementation that the paper audits row-by-row in Tables III and IV, and the run logs from which the percentile latencies and protocol-event counts in Section V are reproducible.
